title: Foot bridges.
officialText:
Where foot bridges are utilized as part of a sidewalk, walkway, or pathway, they shall be provided with
guardrails for the entire length, and shall have cleats to prevent slipping. Where planks are used to pave the walkway of the foot
bridge, the planks shall be laid close and securely fastened to prevent displacement. Planks shall be of uniform thickness, and all
exposed ends of ramps shall be provided with beveled fillers to eliminate tripping hazards.
